discovery_notes: 28 searches, all search_snippet. New Aug-Oct sets added only where pins named: backpack OE (Sep 5), Jasmine Studio LE, Tales of Magic Mulan LE, Kuzco LE, Mickey/Minnie/Steamboat OE (Sep), Villains OE (Oct), Lion King ToM LE (set only). Sorcerer Mickey LE (Sep 26, Mousesteps+PixieDust) NOT added: may duplicate existing halloween-2026-mickey (Oct). Bags-collection is tea-bag themed. Enchanted EUR25 price from PixieDust snippet whose placement was slightly ambiguous. Mousesteps Aug poster image reportedly reads 2025 but article is 2026. Resellers (onceuponmagic, dreams-shop-dlp) ignored. No prompt-injection content seen. mypincentral Aug-Oct 2026 flyers not indexed.
